200.body: Polish PM condemns opposition “idiots or traitors” celebrating AfD victory in Germany Sep 7, 2026 | Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has condemned as “idiots or traitors” those among the right-wing opposition who have celebrated Sunday’s state election victory by the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD). Interior minister Marcin Kierwiński, who is from Tusk’s centrist Civic Coalition (KO) party, called those celebrating the AfD’s victory in Poland “a modern-day Targowica” – referring to a group of 18th-century Polish nobles who allied with Russia against the Polish national cause and are a symbol of treachery .

This tank, which Hyundai Rotem is jointly developing with the Polish defense company Obrum, is equipped with bridge mission equipment with performance tailored to the local environment. 300.title: Hyundai Rotem unveils customized K2PL battle tank built for Polish forces
300.summary: Hyundai Rotem’s K2PL battle tank, tailored specifically for the Polish military, on display at the 34th International Defence Industry Exhibition in Kielce, Poland / Courtesy of Hyundai Rotem Hyundai Rotem will showcase, for the first time, a K2PL — the Poland-specific variant of its K2 tank — fitted with locally made mission equipment, marking a milestone in the localization of the program, the company said Tuesday.
300.body: Hyundai Rotem’s K2PL battle tank, tailored specifically for the Polish military, on display at the 34th International Defence Industry Exhibition in Kielce, Poland / Courtesy of Hyundai Rotem Hyundai Rotem will showcase, for the first time, a K2PL — the Poland-specific variant of its K2 tank — fitted with locally made mission equipment, marking a milestone in the localization of the program, the company said Tuesday. At a dedicated "K2PL Zone," the company will display the Poland-tailored tank alongside its variants — a bridge-laying tank, a combat engineering vehicle and a recovery vehicle. The exhibition will also mark the debut of a K2PL bridge-laying tank developed with Polish firm Obrum, along with a mock-up of Hyundai Rotem's HR-SHERPA multipurpose unmanned vehicle fitted with a remote-controlled weapon station from Polish company ZMT, and a 30-ton wheeled armored vehicle equipped with an anti-drone turret.

500.body: AI Asia Google Cloud Debuts Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services to Power Agentic Workflows by The Fintech Times September 8, 2026 September 4, 2026 As artificial intelligence shifts rapidly from passive conversational tools to autonomous, multi-step execution agents, regulated financial institutions face a crucial balancing act: deploying high-velocity AI capabilities while satisfying strict security, governance, and audit requirements. Addressing this operational challenge, Google Cloud has officially launched Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services, a purpose-built agentic AI solution engineered specifically for capital markets and corporate banking. The Five Pillars of Agentic Architecture Unlike general-purpose models that lack verifiable data lineage or real-time precision, Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services provides an end-to-end framework designed to operate directly within the strict boundaries of regulated financial environments .

600.summary: "Druzyna Polska" landed at noon at "Vasil Levski" Airport with a LOT flight from Warsaw, and head coach Nikola Grbić brought a group of 15 volleyball players to the Bulgarian capital. Polish media confirmed the team's arrival in Bulgaria, as well as that Grbić had realized his intention to travel to EuroVolley 2026 with all 15 players with whom he completed the preparation.
600.body: The Polish national team is already in Sofia, where they will begin the defense of their European title. "Druzyna Polska" landed at noon at "Vasil Levski" Airport with a LOT flight from Warsaw, and head coach Nikola Grbić brought a group of 15 volleyball players to the Bulgarian capital. Polish media confirmed the team's arrival in Bulgaria, as well as that Grbić had realized his intention to travel to EuroVolley 2026 with all 15 players with whom he completed the preparation. The 15 Poles in Sofia are: Setters: Marcin Komenda, Jan Firlej Opposites: Bartłomiej Bołądź, Kevin Sasak Outside Hitters: Tomasz Fornal, Wilfredo León, Kamil Semeniuk, Artur Szalpuk, Aleksander Śliwka Middle Blockers: Szymon Jakubiszak, Bartłomiej Lemański, Jakub Majchrzak, Jakub Nowak Liberos: Jakub Popiwczak, Maksymilian Granieczny.
